newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-HILL OVERWHELMING FAVOURITE TO LIFT TITLE.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-HILL OVERWHELMING FAVOURITE TO LIFT TITLE.

text.p: Britain's Damon Hill is overwhelming favourite to clinch the Formula One world drivers' title in Sunday's final Grand Prix of the season in Suzuka, Japan, bookmakers William Hill said on Thursday.
They put Hill at 1-7 favourite to win the title, while his team mate and closest rival Jacques Villeneuve is only rated at 4-1, although the Canadian is 5-4 favourite to win the race.
If Hill gains a single point he will win the title. William Hill quoted odds of 3-1 of Hill ending the race without a point.
